#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int a[105];
int n, T;

bool check(int k) {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n - k; i++) {
        if (abs(a[i + k - 1] - a[i]) <= T) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        scanf("%d", &a[i]);
    }
    scanf("%d", &T);
    
    sort(a, a + n);
    
    int ans = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        if (check(k)) {
            ans = k;
        }
    }
    
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
